items.note: Governing contract: authoring/docs/html-artifact-contract.md (a task headed Your task names the action and location; a visible peer [data-pep-activity-checks] block labelled What success looks like or Activity checks follows each task; without JavaScript every activity section stays visible) and DESIGN.md (per-activity checks beside the task; Your task names the exact action and where; no hidden author source). The literal four-label numbered-step layout was removed from DESIGN.md by b80bbc4e (#43), so it is no longer mandated; this page still carries it (present at d9019be2 and unchanged in count at HEAD) on top of the current structure. Ruling rule applied to all eight pages: resolved when every hands-on activity has location, action, observable result and done signal somewhere in its numbered path in a followable order (label/content mismatches recorded but non-blocking), and no step supplies the answer to a reasoning step; for scaffold editors, a step that states the complete fill for every placeholder, leaving only transcription, counts as an embedded answer. Activity 1 (prediction) has 4 numbered steps giving location (workspace code), action (choose a prediction and confidence, press the check button) and an observable done signal (feedback below plus Continue) repeated under What success looks like; its third label holds an action and the expectation sits in step 4, a non-blocking label mismatch. Activity 2 (collection sorter) has aligned steps with right/wrong feedback and a done signal. Activity 3 (list and dict statements) has shifted labels but location, action, observable output and done signal are present in order with a 5-item checks list. The final apply activity gives location, action, retry behaviour and done signal under aligned labels. No prediction or MCQ step cues the correct option. Technical check: list/dict mutation, safe missing-key reads and key-value iteration are described accurately. Verified by reading every section#activity-N[data-pep-activity] task block, its checks block and the Activity procedures (text alternative) block (which mirrors the task steps) in the current bytes, plus Playwright Chromium renders: JS enabled at 390x844 (current activity task list with 4 items and checks visible, no page errors) and JS disabled at 1280x900 (every activity section, task steps and checks visible).
